subject: Invoice workflow: who issues invoice + portal opt-in request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Finance AP <ap@acme.com>
Date: 2025-06-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice issuance for Redwood subscription (May 2025)

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well. We’re reconciling May charges and want to confirm the billing flow for Acme Corp moving forward. A couple quick questions: 

- Will Redwood issue the invoice to Acme, or should our AP team expect invoices from an intermediary (e.g., a channel or reseller)?
- We prefer to have invoices delivered to our portal (AP portal) but can accept email copies for the first month. Can you confirm whether you support portal push (SFTP/API) and an email copy fallback?
- Our VAT number is DE123456789. Please include it on the invoice.
- PO number for this subscription: ACME-PO-7782 — please reference on the invoice.

If you can confirm the billing contact (name/email) you’ll use and an example invoice layout (PDF or XML sample) that’d help speed internal approval.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation
Samantha.Lee@acme.com
+1 415 555 0199

[attachment: none yet]

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice issuance for Redwood subscription (May 2025)

Folks — forwarding Acme’s note. Quick proposal below, please weigh in: 

Plan (recommended):
- Offer portal push (SFTP/API) as primary delivery; enable Acme on our portal.
- During portal activation, also send a PDF copy to the AP mailbox (ap@acme.com) for first invoice to reduce friction.
- Ensure VAT number is present and PO ACME-PO-7782 is in invoice header/metadata.
- Connor: can you generate the May invoice and attach a sample e-invoice XML and a redacted PDF example? We should hide unit-level pricing per their later preference (if requested).
- Kimberly: please start portal onboarding (enable account and send onboarding steps + token).

Risks / notes:
- If portal onboarding runs past their cut-off, we should email the PDF to ap@acme.com and push the XML to their SFTP once ready.
- Need to confirm whether Acme requires invoice PDFs to omit unit prices on the public copy (Samantha asked about this in practice).

Thanks — Mark
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample_einvoice_xml.xml (to be generated by Connor)]

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@acme.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-17T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice issuance for Redwood subscription (May 2025)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and the VAT number. Quick summary and next steps from our side: 

- Issuer: Redwood will issue the invoice to Acme Corporation. We will show Redwood Inference as the supplier on the invoice header and include your VAT (DE123456789) and PO ACME-PO-7782.
- Delivery: we will enable portal delivery (SFTP/API) as the canonical channel. While we enable your portal access, we will also email a PDF copy to ap@acme.com for May so your team can process the first payment without delay.
- Redaction: noted — if you need unit prices redacted on the PDF copy we can provide a redacted version. Please confirm whether redaction should apply to both the emailed PDF and the portal PDF payload.

Attached are: 
- invoice_RI-202506-ACME.pdf (PDF copy for processing)
- sample_einvoice_xml.xml (sample payload we push to the portal)

Could you confirm: 1) that the portal opt-in is acceptable, and 2) whether redaction is required on emailed copies, and 3) contact name for the invoice (for billing header)? Once confirmed we’ll finalize and push the files.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: invoice_RI-202506-ACME.pdf (PDF, 88KB); sample_einvoice_xml.xml (XML, 12KB)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Finance AP <ap@acme.com>
Date: 2025-06-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice issuance for Redwood subscription (May 2025)

Thanks Mark — portal opt-in is fine. A few clarifications: 

- Yes please push to our SFTP and copy ap@acme.com. Portal push is primary, email copy is acceptable as a backup/for the first month.
- Please redact unit-level pricing on the emailed PDF (we still want the portal payload to include full pricing for our internal reconciliation).
- Billing contact to appear on invoice: 
  - Name: Samantha Lee
  - Title: Procurement Manager
  - Email: samantha.lee@acme.com
  - PO: ACME-PO-7782 (please reference)

You can proceed with finalizing the May invoice. Appreciate you attaching the sample XML — Connor’s team might follow up with SFTP connection details.
